text: Hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) is a weak base that accumulates in acidic intracellular organelles, such as endosomes, where it increases the luminal pH. This alkalinization inhibits the proteolytic processing and conformational maturation of Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9), thereby preventing the receptor from binding to its ligand, self-nucleic acids, and dampening the aberrant interferon-alpha production characteristic of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
